summary: Full regression on IMAGO dark-theme redesign. All 11 backend pytest tests pass (products, categories, orders with shipping rules, contact, superhero upload validation + full lifecycle + object storage persistence + preview + approve, no exposed source routes). Frontend verified on desktop and mobile: dark body bg (rgb(7,7,10)), no runtime overlay, hero 3D paint lab (R3F canvas) renders and is interactive — marker-cyan + canvas click increments hero-paint-progress 0/7 → 1/7, hero-paint-melanie → 7/7, hero-paint-reset → 0/7. Home page sections, 9 product cards, scroll-paint-story, superhero-band-cta, and bottom-cta-shop all render without pageerrors. Shop page: 9 products, category chip 'animals' filters to 4, quick-add-melanie adds to cart. Product page /product/melanie shows ₪119, includes '6 טושים אקריליים ידידותיים לילדים', qty stepper and add-to-cart update header count. Checkout fills, submits, lands on Bit success screen with 050-333-1809 and IMG-286A25; order persisted in Mongo with status=awaiting_payment, payment_method=bit, total=144. Brush text (מכחול) search across home, shop, product, about, superhero pages returned 0 occurrences after excluding allowed negations; 'טושים אקריליים' is widely present. Mobile viewport (390x844): hero canvas visible, mobile-menu-button opens drawer with all nav links.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~540 lines mixing catalog, orders, superhero pipeline, and Stripe — would benefit from splitting into routers (routers/catalog.py, routers/orders.py, routers/superhero.py, routers/payments.py) once stable.

generate_superhero_preview silently swallows all exceptions and returns FALLBACK_PREVIEW — this is intentional for demo but should log the exc_info for debugging and could expose a server-side status field for the frontend.
React Three Fiber emits a THREE.Clock deprecation + PCFSoftShadowMap removed warnings in console — non-blocking but should be addressed on next three.js upgrade.
seed_data_creation: Created one test order IMG-286A25 (TEST QA User) in orders collection and TEST contact message via /api/contact and TEST_ superhero job via existing tests. All prefixed TEST_* for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_imago_public_api.py cover full catalog/orders/superhero flows and all pass in ~25s. For frontend, Hero3D canvas interactions work via mouse.click on canvas center with marker-* selected. WebGL works in the current browser via software renderer; expect THREE.Clock / PCFSoftShadowMap benign warnings. Checkout happy path writes a bit awaiting_payment order; verify via Mongo query by order_number regex IMG-[A-Z0-9]{6}.
